character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout the full music video: short black hair with a cobalt highlight, dark amber eyes, with a distinct consistent face and adult proportions. Their role is a late-night bicycle messenger crossing the city after the last train. Fixed signature outfit: a black reflective windbreaker with blue piping, messenger harness, and urban sneakers. Defining personal item: a compact route pager clipped to his collar. Preserve the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: This theme follows one fixed protagonist identity from the opening to the finale.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume silhouette, colors, and defining personal item in every scene.
Do not substitute the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in quiet crosswalk, late-night convenience store, overpass walkway; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with midnight blue, amber, concrete gray, neon cyan; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by street-level tracking shot, wide city establishing shot, window reflection close-up; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
